parole.significato: Expression of dismissal following an unmet expectation.
parole.testo: From Cantonese 唓 /𪠳 (ce²) or Singaporean Hokkien 唓 /𪠳 (chhê, expression of dismissal).

parole.significato: Term of address for an elder brother within Chinese families.
parole.testo: From Cantonese 哥哥 (go¹⁻⁴ go¹) or Hokkien 哥哥 (ko-ko). Compare Indonesian koko.

parole.significato: Tagged at the end of a sentence to convey a sense of resignation or inevitability.
parole.testo: From Cantonese 囉 /啰 (lo¹) and Hokkien 囉 /啰 (--lo͘, indicating resignation), which is itself borrowed from Cantonese.

parole.significato: The Chinese tropical fruit tree Litchi chinensis, of the soapberry family.
parole.testo: * /ˈlaɪ̯.t͡ʃi/, /laɪ̯ˈt͡ʃiː/ from Cantonese 荔枝 (lai⁶ zi¹) * /ˈlit͡ʃi/ from Hokkien 荔枝 (lē-chi) Doublet of litchi and lichi.

parole.significato: Asserts that there is a straightforward or self-evident reason for something.
parole.testo: From Cantonese 嘛 (maa³) or Singaporean Hokkien 嘛 (--ma).
